entities.summary: Bruce Greaves McIntosh is an American retired ice hockey defenseman who played in two National Hockey League games with the Minnesota North Stars during the 1972–73 season. McIntosh was signed as a free agent by the North Stars after playing for the University of Minnesota men's hockey team. He now co-owns a Golf Course in northern Minnesota.
